region_prior.interpretation: regional evidence is a conditional prior; no unmapped region label is claimed as DEC face truth

claim_scope: conditional competition score against a participant-built leave-one-out benchmark; not official accuracy and not measured wear truth
limitations: The reference field is constructed from priors and is not an independent physical measurement.
The score can compare frozen alternatives but cannot prove DEC spatial accuracy without a registered baseline/worn scan.
The ensemble's common particle support and high active-face seed CV remain visible in upstream evidence.
